_doc: Semantic roles -> placeholder idx. Same idx in all three styles (dark/green/light). Lists are ordered top-to-bottom / left-to-right. 'auto' slots (header label, slide number) are filled by the builder.

cover.use: Title slide. Logo is part of the layout. Green style is the brand default for covers.

blank.use: Free canvas under a title: native chart, table, image, icons or free text via 'elements'.

rows_bars.use: 3 rows, two parallel columns (A vs B, before | after).

icon_bg_list.use: 3 headed points on the left, big icon/picture on the right.

icon_bg_two_columns.use: 3 rows in two columns plus a big icon/picture.

timeline.use: 5 steps on a time axis: short labels (dates, phases) on top, details in boxes below.

table_3col.use: 3x3 grid: column heads + 3 rows of short cells (8 pt, keep cells to 1-3 short lines).

plate_list.use: Up to 5 rows: label -> description on one plate.

two_plates_conclusion.use: Two options/blocks with tab labels, plus a conclusion line at the bottom.

quote.use: Big quote with author, two supporting text blocks, small footnote.

three_frames.use: 3 parallel blocks: head + text (pillars, options, segments).

three_steps_conclusion.use: 3 numbered steps feeding one conclusion, with notes under it.

three_pills.use: 3 rows: name+description | big value + caption | comment. Good for metrics per item.

four_arrows_conclusion.use: 4 items with details, converging into 2 outcomes on the right.

three_pills_image.use: 3 headed points left, large picture right (no title).

frame_image.use: 2 headed text blocks in a frame + picture.

kpi_2x2.use: 4 KPIs: big value, label, note (order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right).

chart_two_items.use: Chart left; 2 legend items with coloured dots; summary block.

chart_five_items.use: Chart left; up to 5 legend items with coloured dots, each with two short values/notes.

chart_wide.use: Chart left; 3 items with two short values/notes each (no dots).
